🔌 Dimmer Wire Connections (Typical Lutron Dimmer)

While I couldn't find a direct manual for the "6B38" number, here are the typical connections for a Lutron dimmer that uses screw terminals:

  • Green Screw: Connects to the Ground wire (bare copper or green wire) in your wallbox.
  • Black Screw (Darker Color): Connects to the Live Supply wire (the hot wire coming from the circuit breaker/panel).
  • Brass Screw (or one of the lighter colored screws): Connects to the Dimmed Live wire, which goes to the light fixture/load.
  • Blue Screw: This is not used in a standard single-pole installation. It's typically for three-way wiring configurations, connecting to the traveler wire.
  • Silver Screw: Connects to the Neutral wire in the wallbox. Note: Not all dimmers require a neutral connection.

Crucial Safety Note:

  • Always turn off the power at the circuit breaker before disconnecting or connecting any wires.
